/obj/item/clothing/mask/breath.name: breath mask
/obj/item/clothing/mask/breath.reason: Air hookup and nothing else. Standard job kit, 80 cr in the green zone.

/obj/item/clothing/mask/breath/medical.name: medical mask
/obj/item/clothing/mask/breath/medical.reason: Air hookup and germ protection. A doctor's mask.

/obj/item/clothing/mask/breath/muzzle.name: surgery mask
/obj/item/clothing/mask/breath/muzzle.reason: Air hookup and germ protection. A doctor's mask.

/obj/item/clothing/mask/chameleon.name: gas mask
/obj/item/clothing/mask/chameleon.reason: Gas mask that can look like any mask and makes you speak with the name on your ID card. The only real disguise in the slot. It wins by trickery and adds almost no armor. 1,500 cr and a voucher, red zone.

/obj/item/clothing/mask/chameleon/broken.name: gas mask
/obj/item/clothing/mask/chameleon/broken.reason: A chameleon mask with its look stuck. The voice trick still works. One ruin.

/obj/item/clothing/mask/facehugger/lamar.name: Lamarr
/obj/item/clothing/mask/facehugger/lamar.note: A live one leaps at adjacent living carbons with a head (not aliens, nor anyone whose mouth a helmet covers): it tears off their mask, deals 5 brute, knocks them down 5 seconds, heavily tints their vision, muffles speech and cannot be pulled off by hand; after 10 to 15 seconds it implants an alien embryo (organic chest) and dies. It goes idle for 20 to 40 seconds after attaching and dies to heat above 300 K or about 10 damage; the sterile Lamarr variant latches on with no damage or embryo.
/obj/item/clothing/mask/facehugger/lamar.reason: A research director's sterile pet, and no shop, ruin or played hull has it. Latches on, blinds and muffles you, does no harm.

/obj/item/clothing/mask/facescarf.name: facescarf
/obj/item/clothing/mask/facescarf.reason: Cloth scarf that stops smoke and takes an air hookup. Covers the mouth, not the eyes.

/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas.name: gas mask
/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas.reason: Anchor. Stops smoke and pepper spray, covers eyes and mouth, filters bad air, takes an air hookup. Decides a smoke or chemical fight and nothing else. 200 cr in the yellow zone or three in a 400 cr cargo crate.

/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/atmos.name: atmospheric gas mask
/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/atmos.reason: Gas mask with three filter slots and a little fire and acid protection. For atmospheric work.

/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/atmos/centco.name: CentCom gas mask
/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/atmos/centco.reason: Gas mask with three filter slots and a little fire and acid protection. For atmospheric work.

/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/carp.name: carp mask
/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/carp.reason: A working gas mask with a costume look. Covers the eyes, no pepper protection. Crafted from carp hide.

/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/clown_hat.name: clown wig and mask
/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/clown_hat.reason: A costume mask with an air hookup. Doesn't stop smoke.

/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/cyborg.name: cyborg visor
/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/cyborg.reason: A working gas mask with a costume look. Covers the eyes, no pepper protection. One ruin each.

/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/driscoll.name: driscoll mask
/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/driscoll.reason: A working mouth-only gas mask for 35 cr at any ClothesMate. Stops smoke and filters air, leaves the eyes open.

/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/explorer.name: explorer gas mask
/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/explorer.note: Pushing the visor up removes its smoke blocking and internals connection, stops it covering the mouth, and shrinks it from normal to small size so it fits in boxes; pulling it back down restores those.
/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/explorer.reason: Gas mask with a little armor (melee 10, bullet 5) that adds to your helmet's, and it folds down small. 400 cr in the yellow zone; miners start with one. The best ordinary mask.

/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/explorer/fol.name: explorer gas mask
/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/explorer/fol.note: Pushing the visor up removes its smoke blocking and internals connection, stops it covering the mouth, and shrinks it from normal to small size so it fits in boxes; pulling it back down restores those.
/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/explorer/fol.reason: Gas mask with a little armor (melee 10, bullet 5) that adds to your helmet's, and it folds down small. 400 cr in the yellow zone; miners start with one. The best ordinary mask.

/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/jonkler.name: gamer's wig and mask
/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/jonkler.reason: A costume mask with an air hookup. Doesn't stop smoke.

/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/mime.name: mime mask
/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/mime.reason: A costume mask with an air hookup. Doesn't stop smoke.

/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/monkeymask.name: monkey mask
/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/monkeymask.reason: A costume mask with an air hookup. Doesn't stop smoke.

/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/ninja.name: ninja mask
/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/ninja.reason: Covers the mouth, stops smoke and pepper spray. Black market only.

/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/prop.name: prop gas mask
/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/prop.reason: A prop gas mask that doesn't work as one.

/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/sechailer.name: security gas mask
/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/sechailer.reason: Stops smoke and filters air but leaves the eyes open, so no pepper protection. Security job gear.

/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/sechailer/sw.name: SWAT mask
/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/sechailer/sw.reason: A gas mask with a security hailer. In ruin caches, one ruin and the security chief's garment bag.

/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/syndicate.name: syndicate mask
/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/syndicate.reason: A gas mask with a darker look. In suit storage on 2 hulls.

/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/tiki_mask.name: tiki mask
/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/tiki_mask.reason: A working gas mask with a costume look. Covers the eyes, no pepper protection. One ruin each.

/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/welding.name: welding mask
/obj/item/clothing/mask/gas/welding.reason: Gas mask with a welding visor: stops flashes and arcs, fireproof, melee 10, but darkens your view. Prints after research.

/obj/item/clothing/mask/gondola.name: gondola mask
/obj/item/clothing/mask/gondola.reason: A fur costume mask. Hides your face and garbles your speech.

/obj/item/clothing/mask/muzzle.name: muzzle
/obj/item/clothing/mask/muzzle.reason: Gags whoever wears it. A restraint.

/obj/item/clothing/mask/whistle/sergeant.name: sergeant's whistle
/obj/item/clothing/mask/whistle/sergeant.note: Blowing it removes half of the remaining stun and knockdown time of every living creature that hears it within 7 tiles, allies and enemies alike, and gives them a 4 second speed boost. 60 second cooldown.
/obj/item/clothing/mask/whistle/sergeant.reason: Authored one-off from an armory cache. Blowing it halves the remaining stun and knockdown of everyone within 7 tiles, enemies too, with a 4 second speed boost. Every 60 seconds.

method: No number. The slot's job is air, smoke and pepper spray, and any of the working gas masks does that job, so they all sit at green with rank set by what they add. Mask armor is small and adds to the helmet's. Only the disguise mask and the one authored whistle rate above green.
